description: This file defines a React functional component 'HelpAndFeedback' rendering a help and feedback UI section for the application, including FAQ, community links, and policies, with event handling for link clicks and mobile-specific behavior.

methods.name: openLinkOnMobile
methods.description: Opens a URL in the mobile device using the application object, if on a native mobile web platform.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events on links, preventing default behavior and opening the URL via mobile device if applicable.
